name: paper-spirit-zine
title_zh: 把一张照片变成触感纸本海报，原图情绪做主
tagline_zh: 照片仍是主角，下方纸面长出山脊、水痕、风迹或呼吸印。适合做编辑海报、摄影记忆标本，或抖音艺术切片。
tagline_en: Photo stays primary; lower paper grows ridges, shorelines, wind traces, breath marks. For editorial posters.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into a tactile Paper Spirit Zine poster where the original photograph remains emotionally primary and the lower paper field becomes a source-derived living afterimage: ridge, shoreline, shadow, wind trace, breath mark, or only-if-earned animal-like vessel. Use for photo-to-zine editorial posters, paper afterimages, photographic memory specimens, Douyin-ready art ser
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，而是让纸面成为照片的‘活余像’——纹理由原图推导生成，情绪从照片延续到纸域，而非生硬拼贴。
why_en: Not a filter stack—the paper field is a living afterimage derived from the source photo, so texture inherits emotion instead of.
limit_zh: 仅接受单张用户照片输入；只产出静态海报，不生成动图或视频。纹理形态限于山脊、岸线、阴影、风迹、呼吸印。
limit_en: Single photo in, static poster out. Textures limited to ridge/shore/shadow/wind/breath; animal vessel only if earned by the image. No video, no.
title_en: Turn one photo into a tactile paper zine poster, photo.
